items.title: Navy, Shipbuilders Bringing Robots Online to Build, Maintain Fleet
items.summary:
The robotics used in the HYPR program will come in a range of form factors, Kabir said. Some operations will call for smaller robots to perform work in confined spaces, while blasting or coating the exterior of a ship will require larger systems.

GrayMatter Robotics will be performing grinding, blasting, coating, inspection and a few other applications for HYPR, while Path Robotics will be doing welding, he added. [...] That is the goal of the High-Yield Production Robotics, or HYPR, program launched by shipbuilder HII, GrayMatter Robotics and Path Robotics in April. Through this effort, HII will utilize a network of physical AI technologies developed by the two robotics firms “to rapidly accelerate advanced, adaptive automation solutions in the fabrication process of both crewed and uncrewed naval platforms,” a company release stated. [...] Traditionally, robotics used in factories are hard-coded and pre-programmed to do the same thing millions and millions of times, he said. However, the vast majority of manufacturing — approximately 90 percent — features high variability due to complex material and environmental physics. For example, the paint used on fighter jets may have a different thickness or viscosity depending on the batch or the supplier.

items.title: Developing Healthcare Robotics with GPU-Native Medical ...
items.summary:
Healthcare robotics faces critical challenges in data scarcity, generalization, and development velocity due to limited access to annotated demonstrations, the prevalence of rare but clinically important scenarios, and slow, resource-intensive prototyping cycles. [...] AI-generated content may summarize information incompletely. Verify important information. Learn more

Unlike autonomous driving or industrial robotics, healthcare robotics can’t rely on internet-scale data collection or unlimited real-world experimentation. Every demonstration requires specialized equipment, clinical expertise, and access to patients or laboratory environments. This creates three fundamental challenges for developers. [...] The third challenge is development velocity. Medical robotics development relies on benchtop phantoms, cadaver studies, animal models, and limited clinical evaluations. These remain essential, but they are inherently sequential, expensive, and difficult to scale. Iterating on designs and algorithms currently takes months, pushing total development cycles to 4–7 years.

result.actual_text:
Dưới đây là danh sách các công cụ mà tôi có thể sử dụng:

1. **trending_topics**: Lấy danh sách chủ đề đang trending trên Twitter theo khu vực.
2. **timeline**: Lấy các bài đăng gần đây từ một tài khoản Twitter cụ thể.
3. **social_search**: Tìm kiếm trên mạng xã hội theo từ khóa.
4. **lookup**: Tra cứu thông tin trên internet.
5. **fetch**: Lấy nội dung từ một địa chỉ URL.
6. **format**: Trình bày dữ liệu đã có thành văn bản.
7. **send**: Gửi một đoạn văn bản đi.
8. **policy**: Tìm trong tài liệu nội bộ.
9. **papers**: Tìm bài báo khoa học.
10. **paper_text**: Lấy nội dung text của một bài báo.

Nếu bạn cần thêm thông tin về bất kỳ công cụ nào, hãy cho tôi biết!
